newsitem.title: USA: Giddings & Lewis Q1 net off, margin up.
newsitem.headline: Giddings & Lewis Q1 net off, margin up.

text.p: Giddings & Lewis Inc said Thursday its gross margin improved in spite of a decline in earnings in the first quarter ended March 30.
The industrial automation products and machine tool supplier reported net income of $7.4 million, or $0.22 a share, down from $10.4 million, or $0.30, a year ago.
Sales in the period fell to $117.6 million from $192.4 million, a decline Giddings & Lewis said it expected because of lower order backlog at the beginning of the year.
The company also said its gross margin increased to $26.9 percent of sales from 22.2 percent last year, thanks to increased productivity, better pricing and product mix.
Giddings & Lewis shares were off 1/8 Thursday at 13-1/4.
